intro: Four musicians from England, together from 1968 until John Bonham's death in 1980. Each chose a symbol for the sleeve of the fourth album, which carried no title and no band name.

members.name: Jimmy Page
members.note: A busy London session guitarist before joining the Yardbirds in 1966. He formed Led Zeppelin from the end of that band and produced every one of its albums.

members.name: Robert Plant
members.note: Sang with Midlands groups including the Band of Joy before Page recruited him in 1968. Wrote most of the band's lyrics.

members.name: John Paul Jones
members.note: A session player and arranger who had worked with Page in the studio. On stage he moved between bass, organ, piano and mandolin.

members.name: John Bonham
members.note: Played with Plant in the Band of Joy. His death in September 1980 ended the band; the other three said they could not go on as they were.

also.name: Jason Bonham
also.note: John Bonham's son played drums at the 1988 Atlantic Records show and at the O2 Arena in 2007.
